Chronology of every recorded fact about [[sacred beast]], in reading order. Generated from the same verified fact store as the main article.

== Soulsmith ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|'''Ch 17''' — Dreadbeasts are effectively monstrous sacred artists like sacred beasts.}}

== Skysworn ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|'''Ch 1''' — Sacred beasts live in the branches of ancestral trees and feed on leftovers or spirit-fruit.}}

== Underlord ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|'''Ch 8''' — Sacred beasts advance differently than humans.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|'''Ch 8''' — Sacred beasts must choose who they are rather than discovering it.}}

== Wintersteel ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|'''Ch 7''' — A giant pig corpse fell out of a void key and possessed the spiritual pressure of an Overlord.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|'''Ch 8''' — A tiny sacred beast that looks like a baby rabbit has a sharp horn of frozen ice.}}

== Bloodline ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|'''Ch 16''' — Sacred beasts can grow larger than a pregnant mountain.}}

== Reaper ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|'''Ch 24''' — Remnants creep by newborn sacred beasts in the Silent King's domain.}}

== Dreadgod ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|'''Ch 15''' — Orthos was an honored sacred beast considered nobility.}}

== Waybound ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|'''Ch 23''' — Two fish-people are sacred beasts that have taken on humanoid form.}}

== Threshold: Stories from Cradle ==
